heading: The Marginarium: how it was made
first_line: Paint by Moonlight turns a photo into a paint-by-number on the device; the Marginarium tells how Paul and his AI agents made it.
content_why: She gives away what she loves most, so the full chapters go up word for word instead of waiting for the app.
avoid: Avoid polite, tidy README copy that sands off the Lamp's voice and reads like any other app's landing page.
